31b26c3bf982de1ed3231c39007c78b5ba06eda5.rawDescription:
We are looking for a Social Media Manager with experience in ads management and basic graphic design to grow and engage our online audience. You’ll be responsible for creating and scheduling content, running paid ad campaigns, and designing simple graphics to support marketing efforts.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and manage social media strategies across platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.).
Plan, set up, and optimise paid ad campaigns (Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, Google Ads).
Create and schedule engaging posts, stories, and reels.
Design basic graphics using Canva or Adobe tools to enhance content.
Analyse performance metrics and adjust strategies to improve results.
Stay updated on social media trends and best practices.
Engage with the audience and respond to comments/messages.

Requirements

Requirements:

Experience in social media management and ads management (Facebook Business Manager is a plus).
Basic design skills (Canva or Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator).
Strong copywriting and content creation abilities.
Analytical mindset with knowledge of social media insights and reporting.
Organised, creative, and able to work independently.

Benefits

Flexible, part-time, remote work schedule – perfect for freelancers or professionals seeking additional income.
Performance-based earning potential – you’ll be paid £40 per campaign, with monthly income based on the number of campaigns you take on. The more campaigns you manage, the more you earn—you control your workload and income.
Be part of a supportive, collaborative, and purpose-driven remote team.
Access to professional development resources and opportunities to expand your skills.

46ccc975d8533be753f3f5f7445a3b3e07de4e3a.rawDescription:
Social Media Manager (Freelance – Remote)

About Us:
We are a London-based video production agency working across a range of industries including dentistry, jewellery, small business, and education. Our content is narrative-led and video-first — we produce everything from Instagram Reels and TikToks to brand films and interview-led website videos.
We are looking for a freelance Social Media Manager to join our remote team on an ongoing basis, taking ownership of client social media accounts using the content we produce.

Working Hours:
Ability to overlap with UK working hours when required
After probation, the majority of work may be completed during Philippine working hours
This role requires someone who can problem-solve independently while the UK team is offline

Role Overview:
Content is filmed and produced by our UK production team. Your role is to manage the delivery, scheduling, and performance of that content across client social platforms — and to build and execute strategies that grow followers, views, and engagement on Instagram and other platforms.
Growing accounts is at the heart of this role. We want someone who understands what makes people follow, watch, and come back — and who can demonstrate they've done it before.

Responsibilities:
Develop and execute social media strategies tailored to each client's goals
Drive meaningful growth in followers, views, and engagement — not just vanity metrics
Focus on attracting relevant, engaged audiences who convert into real business results
Write captions that reflect each client's voice and audience
Manage scheduled posting across platforms (primarily Instagram and TikTok)
Create and post Stories where appropriate
Engage with relevant accounts, brands, and communities on behalf of clients
Monitor performance and feed insights back to the UK team
Support overall account growth using video-led content

Requirements
We are looking for someone who:

Has a proven track record of growing Instagram accounts — in followers, reach, and engagement
Has a strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok, including how the algorithms work
Can write confidently in different brand voices
Is comfortable managing multiple client accounts simultaneously
Has a genuine eye for what makes content perform
Is organised, deadline-driven, and comfortable working remotely
Can identify and solve problems independently when the UK team is offline

Tools & Workflow
Applicants should be comfortable working with:

Scheduling and social media management tools
Microsoft Teams / Tasks
OneDrive or cloud-based file sharing

Availability

Freelance role
Initially contracted for approximately 1–2 days per week
Ongoing work available for the right candidate

Application Requirements
Please include:

A short introduction:
Examples of social media accounts you have helped manage or grow — we especially want to see accounts where you've made a measurable difference
Growth metrics: follower counts, reach, engagement rates, or any results you're proud of
Any before-and-after comparisons that demonstrate your impact
General weekly availability
Professional references

Pay: From Php200.00 per hour

Benefits:

Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
